items.title: Jimmy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Didn’t Victor Goines takeover? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, they appointed him afterwards but I had given the first refusal.

ctx.x: happened was they were asking me, “Did I think that Julliard could have a jazz program?” And I said, “What do you mean? You’ve got one of the most prestigious music schools in the world. Sure, you can have a jazz program!” They said, “Yes, but one hears…” And I say, “But this is Julliard isn’t it?” I said, “But you finally got around to accepting this music.” So I said when I got the honorary doctorate, I said, “I should have cut them up earlier.” (Laughs) Maybe I would have gotten that early. I kind of put them…
Well, they appointed him afterwards but I had given the first refusal.
